fittings.subtitle: EO2-Plus Technology — Global Leak-Free Standard Since the 1930s
fittings.description: Safety in extreme pressure conditions up to 800 bar. Ease of assembly, reliability, compactness.
fittings.aboutDesc: Ermeto Original tube fittings have gained recognition due to high efficiency and compactness. Today, the EO2 system is the most common solution in the world for metric tubes.
fittings.adv_seal_desc: Prevents penetration of air and contaminants
fittings.section_cycle_desc: We ensure comprehensive supply of components and create fully leak-free hydraulic lines 'turnkey', taking responsibility for every joint.
fittings.section_heritage_desc: From the invention of the Ermeto bite-type fitting in the 1930s to Parker's global leadership
fittings.section_heritage_desc_part2: today. Millions of installations confirm the status of the gold standard in mobile hydraulics and heavy industry.
fittings.section_stages_desc_part2: at every stage guarantees a flawless and predictable result.
fittings.section_stage_01_desc: Perpendicular cutting, deburring and precision cleaning of the tube internal cavity.
fittings.section_stage_02_desc: Pre-assembly and final tightening with rigid control of the functional nut stop.
fittings.section_stage_03_desc: Final hydraulic tests of the system under working and peak pressure before delivery.
fittings.section_core_desc: Innovative separation of retention and sealing functions. The elastomeric sealing effect is reinforced by the system working pressure.
fittings.section_series_desc: Correct choice of fitting series determines the reliability of the entire hydraulic line. Below are the main characteristics of Parker Ermeto series.
fittings.section_safety_desc: Elimination of the human factor thanks to the design features of Parker Ermeto.
fittings.section_safety_item_01_desc: Noticeable effort during assembly eliminates the risk of over-tightening or under-tightening, guaranteeing accuracy.
fittings.section_safety_item_02_desc: The EO2-Plus design allows for multiple disassembly and re-assembly of the unit without loss of leak-tightness.
fittings.section_mastery_desc: Our service is adapted to your conditions — from a stationary workshop to a remote quarry.
fittings.section_mastery_item_01_desc: Fully equipped mobile workshops for installation anywhere in Kazakhstan.
fittings.section_mastery_item_02_desc: Training of your personnel and technical supervision of the assembly process at large industrial sites.
fittings.section_physics_desc: Extreme testing guarantees performance in the harshest operating conditions.
fittings.section_coating_desc: Multi-layer protection without Chrome(VI) content. 500 hours of corrosion resistance and full compliance with EU environmental directives (ELV 2000/53/EG).
fittings.section_pipes_desc: Tube surface quality directly affects leak-tightness. We use only seamless CFA / CFG tubes.
fittings.section_pipe_01_desc: Minimum condition. Exceeding the threshold (CFD tubes) leads to micro-leaks.
fittings.section_pipe_02_desc: Strict compliance with D4/D3 tolerances for flawless ring biting.
fittings.section_pipe_03_desc: Clean surface without scale, which is critical for EO2 soft seals.
fittings.section_value_desc: Professional installation is an investment in lack of downtime, environmental safety and long equipment life.
fittings.section_value_item_01_desc: We take full responsibility for the lack of leaks on installed lines.
fittings.section_value_item_02_desc: The EO2 system in the hands of professionals allows speeding up the installation process by up to 40% compared to analogs.
fittings.section_orig_desc: Protecting your investments from counterfeits and low-quality analogs that are dangerous for the system.
fittings.section_orig_item_01_desc: Applied to all original 24° fittings (Ermeto Original).
fittings.section_orig_item_02_desc: Parker quality mark on Triple-Lok, O-Lok and BSP adapters.
fittings.section_orig_item_03_desc: Special silver plating of nuts for stainless steel fittings.
fittings.cta_title: Ready to Switch Your Hydraulics to Parker Standard?
fittings.faq_q1: How is leak-tightness guaranteed after installation?
fittings.faq_a1: We use the Parker EO-2 system with elastomeric sealing, which eliminates the 'human factor'. After assembly, each line undergoes visual control and, if necessary, pressure testing under working pressure.
fittings.faq_a2: In the EO-2 system, the functional nut and seal are replaceable components. If the disassembly regulation is followed, the fitting body remains suitable for multiple reuse.
fittings.faq_q3: What equipment do you use for installation?
fittings.faq_a3: Installation is performed using professional Parker equipment: pre-assembly machines and precision tube cutters. This guarantees perfect biting geometry.
fittings.faq_q4: Do you work with site visits?
fittings.faq_a4: Yes, our 'Parker Mobile Center' service is equipped with everything necessary for high-quality assembly and installation of pipelines directly at the site of your equipment operation.

diagnostics.photo_desc: A wide-format photograph of the diagnostic process will be placed here.
diagnostics.description: Comprehensive technical inspection of hydraulic systems using Parker diagnostic equipment. We find the causes of breakdowns where others see normal operation.
diagnostics.aboutDesc: We use professional Parker ServiceMaster Plus diagnostic systems. This allows us to see the system "from the inside" in dynamics, recording any deviations from the norm before they lead to a fatal failure.
diagnostics.subtitle: We eliminate guesswork. Using high-frequency Parker sensors, we capture the 1ms pressure spikes that cause catastrophic equipment failure.
diagnostics.versus_quote: "Just because your gauge reads 200 bar doesn't mean you didn't have a destructive 400 bar spike a millisecond ago."
diagnostics.correlation_desc: We analyze the system as an integrated whole. Our diagnostics identify hidden dependencies—such as how overheating (T) in one circuit impacts volumetric efficiency (Q) and triggers pressure spikes (P) during rapid RPM (N) fluctuations.
diagnostics.plug_work_desc: Parker's sensor auto-recognition technology has been the industry benchmark since 1989. It's more than convenience; it's a fail-safe against human error during critical system measurements.
diagnostics.readiness_desc: Connect a sensor—the device instantly recognizes its range, measurement units, and calibration data.
diagnostics.error_protection_desc: Eliminates the risk of manual data entry errors or incorrect scale selection in high-stakes environments.
diagnostics.process_results_desc: We deliver more than data—we provide a reliability guarantee and a strategic roadmap to drastically reduce your TCO (Total Cost of Ownership).
diagnostics.process_desc_01: Installation of high-precision sensors into system control ports without interrupting production.
diagnostics.process_desc_02: Recording full operational cycles under various load conditions with sampling rates up to 1000 Hz.
diagnostics.process_desc_03: Deep log processing, anomaly detection, and calculating component degradation metrics.
diagnostics.process_desc_04: Issuing a comprehensive expert report and a predictive maintenance roadmap.
diagnostics.results_desc: Our audit results are not just numbers—they are a survival guide for your hydraulic machinery.
diagnostics.pain_01_desc: Hoses failing without a clear cause? We identify the hidden pressure spikes that destroy them.
diagnostics.pain_02_desc: System overheating and power loss? We pinpoint the exact bypass or friction point causing heat.
diagnostics.pain_03_desc: Actuators moving slowly? We detect internal bypass in pumps or cylinders with 99% accuracy.
diagnostics.pain_04_desc: Odd sounds in the system? We'll detect cavitation and aeration in the suction lines before failure.
diagnostics.economics_inv_footer_main: Full ROI typically achieved after first audit
diagnostics.economics_risk_footer: Aggregated data from major KZ industrial enterprises
diagnostics.report_desc: You receive a comprehensive, actionable technical report with full transient analysis, verified by calibrated Parker instrumentation.
diagnostics.report_item_01_desc: Pressure spikes up to 420 bar detected (Rated: 280 bar).
diagnostics.kits_editorial_desc: We use only certified Parker equipment to ensure 100% measurement accuracy and result repeatability.
diagnostics.kits_item_01_desc: Digital gauge for high-speed pressure monitoring.
diagnostics.kits_item_03_desc: Multi-channel data logger for complete system analysis.
diagnostics.kits_item_04_desc: Turbine flow meters with integrated load simulation.
diagnostics.kits_footer_desc: All audit kits are self-contained with Test-Point couplings and adapters.
diagnostics.instruments_desc: From mobile handhelds for line mechanics to laboratory-grade analyzers for deep system audits.
diagnostics.instrument_01_desc: Rapid pressure and temperature checks in field environments.
diagnostics.instrument_02_desc: Log recording, waveform graphing, and micro-leak detection.
diagnostics.analysis_desc: We don't just capture data—we interpret it using specialized Parker SensoWin analytics.
diagnostics.analysis_software_desc: Graph overlay, cycle comparison, and dynamic load-profile calculation.
diagnostics.analysis_cloud_desc: Access your equipment's full measurement history instantly from the cloud.
diagnostics.aboutDesc: Digital audit of hydraulic systems from Saruzhan Engineering allows identifying hidden defects that cannot be detected by conventional pressure gauges. We use high-frequency Parker equipment to record transient processes in real time.
diagnostics.cta_title: Ready for a digital audit of your system?
diagnostics.faq_a1: A standard audit of one system takes from 2 to 4 hours of operation under load.
diagnostics.faq_q2: Do I need to stop production?
diagnostics.faq_a2: No, diagnostics are carried out on operating equipment in real operating modes.
diagnostics.faq_a3: We simultaneously measure pressure (P), temperature (T), flow (Q), and speed (N) at a frequency of up to 1000 Hz.
diagnostics.faq_q4: What will I get in the end?
diagnostics.faq_a4: You will receive a detailed technical report with graphs, fault analysis, and recommendations for their elimination.
diagnostics.reliability_plus_desc: Prevention of sudden breakdowns through early detection of component wear.
diagnostics.cert_report_desc: An official document with graphs and expert opinion for the service book.
diagnostics.opt_procurement_desc: Purchase only those spare parts that actually need replacement.
diagnostics.zero_downtime_desc: Checking systems in dynamics without dismantling components and stopping the technological process.
